indicators.name: AI Readiness Score
indicators.description: Overall Government AI Readiness score from Oxford Insights, combining Government, Technology Sector, and Data & Infrastructure pillars.

indicators.name: Government Pillar
indicators.description: Government pillar score — strategic vision, governance, ethics, and digital capacity.

indicators.name: Technology Sector Pillar
indicators.description: Technology sector pillar — innovation capacity, human capital, business environment.

indicators.name: Data & Infrastructure Pillar
indicators.description: Data & infrastructure pillar — data availability, representativeness, and digital infrastructure.

indicators.name: % Nervous About AI
indicators.description: Percentage who agree 'products and services using AI make me nervous' (Ipsos AI Monitor 2024, 32 countries).

indicators.name: % Excited About AI
indicators.description: Percentage who agree 'products and services using AI make me excited' (Ipsos AI Monitor 2024, 32 countries).

indicators.name: % Expect AI to Change Their Life
indicators.description: Percentage who think AI will profoundly change their daily life in the next 3-5 years (Ipsos AI Monitor 2024).

indicators.name: % Trust AI Data Protection
indicators.description: Percentage who trust companies using AI to protect their personal data (Ipsos AI Monitor 2024).

indicators.name: Policy Capacity (2025)
indicators.description: Policy capacity pillar — strategic vision, governance frameworks, and digital capacity (2025 index).

indicators.name: AI Infrastructure (2025)
indicators.description: AI infrastructure pillar — compute access, connectivity, and digital readiness (2025 index).

indicators.name: Governance (2025)
indicators.description: Governance pillar — AI ethics, regulation, and accountability frameworks (2025 index).

indicators.name: Public Sector Adoption (2025)
indicators.description: Public sector adoption pillar — AI use in government services (2025 index).

indicators.name: Development & Diffusion (2025)
indicators.description: Development & diffusion pillar — innovation capacity and business AI adoption (2025 index).

indicators.name: Resilience (2025)
indicators.description: Resilience pillar — economic stability, human capital, and societal adaptability (2025 index).
